def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Find the uniform divider that splits the grid into equal-sized panels.
    divider = None
    for r in range(h):
        if (h - 1) % 2 == 0 and all(x == grid[r][0] for x in grid[r]):
            divider = ("row", r)
            break
    if divider is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if (w - 1) % 2 == 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
                divider = ("col", c)
                break

    if divider[0] == "row":
        r = divider[1]
        top, bottom = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
        shared = set(x for row in top for x in row) & set(x for row in bottom for x in row)
        color = next(iter(shared))
        return [[3 if a == b == color else color for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]

    c = divider[1]
    left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
    right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
    shared = set(x for row in left for x in row) & set(x for row in right for x in row)
    color = next(iter(shared))
    return [[3 if a == b == color else color for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
            for ra, rb in zip(left, right)]
